README excerpt: AbliteratedOutTheBox What is AbliteratedOutTheBox? AbliteratedOutTheBox is a fork of llama.cpp that gets any supported model to answer flagged harmful prompts, delivering the requested content instead of a refusal, at inference time and with the original weights left on disk unchanged. It needs no fit, no training, and no extra files: for each prompt llama-abliterate reads two directions from the prompt itself, by forcing the assistant to start a few comply versus refuse openings (and clean versus disclaimered openings), diffing the activations, and a look-ahead gate decides per prompt whether to remove them. Drop it in, and the agent stops hedging, stops moralizing, stops fading to black, and stops asking permission for work you already asked for. It is written as a constitution rather than a task list: role, capabilities, values, domains of assistance, a narrowly drawn safety policy, refusal handling, a reasoning procedure, response quality, tone, and session conduct. No tool-specific syntax, no project-specific rules — it works anywhere an AGENTS.md -style instruction file is read.
